morning.caption:
The EU and UK agreed on Nov 20 to link their carbon markets from 2028, recognizing each other's allowances and exempting traded goods from carbon border charges. Industry says cross-border CO2 storage could cut costs by up to 28%.

What it means for investors, regulators and industry at carbonenergynexus.com

#CarbonMarkets #EUETS #UKETS #CCS #CBAM

midday.caption:
Nordic Ren-Gas reached a final investment decision on its Tampere e-methane plant: more than €300 million, about 190 GWh a year from renewable hydrogen and biogenic CO2, backed by Allianz, the EIB and others.

More at carbonenergynexus.com

#Hydrogen #EFuels #Finland #CarbonCapture

evening.caption:
COP31 in Antalya missed its Nov 20 close. The draft has no fossil fuel language and keeps a 35% electrification goal, some countries object to its carbon capture call, and Panama threatens to block a deal.

More at carbonenergynexus.com
